To determine how long it will take Joy to read 120 pages, we need to first find out how many pages she reads per minute. We know that she can read 8 pages in 20 minutes. Therefore, her reading rate is:

\[
\text{Reading rate} = \frac{8 \text{ pages}}{20 \text{ minutes}} = \frac{2 \text{ pages}}{5 \text{ minutes}}
\]

This means she reads 2 pages every 5 minutes. To find out how many pages she reads in one minute, we divide 2 pages by 5 minutes:

\[
\text{Pages per minute} = \frac{2 \text{ pages}}{5 \text{ minutes}} = \frac{2}{5} \text{ pages per minute}
\]

Now, we need to calculate how long it will take her to read 120 pages. Since she reads 2 pages per minute, the time required to read 120 pages is:

\[
\text{Time} = \frac{120 \text{ pages}}{\frac{2 \text{ pages}}{5 \text{ minutes}}} = 120 \times \frac{5}{2} = 120 \times 2.5 = 300 \text{ minutes}
\]

To convert the time from minutes to hours, we divide by 60 (since there are 60 minutes in an hour):

\[
\text{Time in hours} = \frac{300 \text{ minutes}}{60 \text{ minutes per hour}} = 5 \text{ hours}
\]

Thus, it will take Joy \boxed{5} hours to read 120 pages.
